description: Create a human approval request for an irreversible action. Returns approve_url (pass it to the responsible human through your own channel) and approval_id. Optional wait_seconds keeps the call open (progress notifications every 10 s when the client sends a progressToken) until the human decides. 3 free per day, then 0.005 USDC via x402 (params._meta["x402/payment"]).

action_summary.description: Plain-language description of the irreversible action awaiting approval

callback_url.description: Optional public https URL that receives a POST with the signed receipt when decided

expires_in_s.description: Seconds until the request expires unanswered (default 3600)

requester.description: Optional label shown to the approver, e.g. agent or job name

risk.description: Risk level shown to the approver (default med)

wait_seconds.description: Optional: wait up to this many seconds for the decision before returning (0 = return immediately; >25 needs an SSE-capable client)

name: request_approval
title: Request human approval
